# Mohamed Zahran

> Software engineer at RICOH Europe (formerly CORELIA), based in Cairo, Egypt. Ships six production enterprise systems in parallel, end to end: React 19 and Next.js front ends, NestJS and ASP.NET Core services, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQL Server, plus agentic AI systems (LangGraph pipelines, LLM tool-calling with SSE streaming).

## Current role

Full Stack Engineer at RICOH Europe (November 2025 - present). Owns full-stack delivery across six production enterprise systems in parallel under the CORELIA program, from technical design through deployment and stabilization:

- 3D Building & Space Viewer: multi-mode 3D viewer (Dollhouse / Panorama / Split) with room-aware navigation, React 19 + React Three Fiber / Three.js
- Tailgating Detection System: real-time anomaly dashboard with live MJPEG streaming and license-plate OCR workflows (React 18, Redux Toolkit, TanStack Query)
- AGL Invoice Management: OCR-backed invoice verification pipeline over SharePoint and AS400 (React, TypeScript, TanStack Query)
- RicohFacturation: supplier invoice control platform in Blazor WebAssembly + ASP.NET Core with PostgreSQL and Docker Compose
- Qalam Vision: Arabic/multilingual NLP keyword-extraction interface integrating Label Studio
- CORELIA Next Boilerplate: authored the team's frontend platform (typed routes, Zod guards, Vitest/Playwright, Docker behind Nginx via GitLab CI)
- Works AI-first with Claude Code and Codex coding agents: specs before generation, every line reviewed and understood, merges gated on CI test suites (504 tests on the latest AI system, 409 on MAC-Egypt)

## Experience

- Full Stack Engineer, RICOH Europe, Cairo - Nov 2025 to present. Six production enterprise systems in parallel under the CORELIA program; authored the team's Next.js boilerplate

- Frontend Lead, GDSC - Shorouk Academy - Aug 2023 to Jun 2025. Ran React/Next.js/TypeScript workshops for 50+ students
